aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.description: Meet VetHealth Banja Luka – a veterinary clinic caring for your pets' health since 2016.
aboutPage.storyP1: VetHealth.ba was founded in 2009 with a clear vision – to provide top-quality veterinary care for all pets in Banja Luka and the wider region. From humble beginnings in a small clinic, we have grown into a modern veterinary facility with complete equipment.
aboutPage.storyP2: Our team consists of experienced veterinarians and specialists who share the same passion – love for animals and dedication to their health. We believe every pet deserves the best possible care, regardless of whether it's a routine check-up or complex surgery.
aboutPage.storyP3: We pay special attention to a comprehensive and personalized approach to every patient. Every dog and cat has specific needs, so we tailor our approach to their health condition, age and lifestyle.
aboutPage.valuesDesc: At VetHealth we believe quality veterinary care starts with a careful approach to every patient and the trust we build with its owner. Our goal is to combine expertise, modern veterinary medicine and an understanding of every pet's needs.
aboutPage.value3: Continuous education and following new methods
aboutPage.ourTeamDesc: Expertise, attention and a sincere attitude towards animals and the people who care for them.
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Book an appointment today and see why over 5,000 owners recommend us.
aboutPage.storyP4: Our goal is to provide quality veterinary care in one place – from preventive check-ups and diagnostics to treatment and surgery – with expertise, attention and a relationship that builds long-term trust.
aboutPage.vetBio1: Vladimir Ilić, DVM, graduated in veterinary medicine in 2011 in Novi Sad. Over many years of work he has focused especially on surgery and clinical practice, with continuous professional development and following advances in veterinary medicine.
aboutPage.vetBio2: Experience in laboratory diagnostics, as well as daily work with a wide range of health problems in dogs and cats, has allowed him to develop a systematic approach to diagnosis and treatment.
aboutPage.vetBio3: It is especially important to him to approach every patient individually, with careful assessment of their health and open communication with the owner. He believes a good veterinarian, besides expert knowledge, needs patience, understanding and a sincere attitude towards animals and the people who care for them.
aboutPage.vetBio4: Alongside clinical work, he takes part in educating owners through professional articles and content on pet health and disease prevention.
aboutPage.techRole: Veterinary Technician | Student at the Faculty of Agriculture
aboutPage.techBio1: Nemanja Dragišić is a veterinary technician and a student at the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Banja Luka. Through his work at VetHealth he gains valuable practical experience and improves his knowledge of working with animals every day.
aboutPage.techBio2: In his work he pays special attention to careful and responsible handling of patients, as well as providing support during examinations, diagnostics and therapeutic procedures.
aboutPage.techBio3: Dedicated to learning and development, Nemanja strives to apply his knowledge through practical work and to contribute to quality care for every patient.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to questions our clients ask most often.

q1.q: Do I need to book an appointment?
q1.a: We recommend calling ahead to avoid waiting. Emergencies are accepted without an appointment.

q2.a: We treat dogs, cats, small rodents, birds and exotic pets.

q3.a: Saturdays follow the schedule shown on the page. We are closed on Sundays.

q4.a: Yes, we accept cash and all major payment cards.

q5.q: How do I prepare my pet for a visit?
q5.a: Bring the health booklet and a list of medications. Lab tests may require 8–12 hours of fasting — please consult us in advance.
